composers_checked.name: Weingartner, Felix

composers_checked.name: Foote, Arthur
composers_checked.note: Complete. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list and Naxos discs: String Quartet No. 1 (Op. 4) and Nocturne and Scherzo added. At Dusk (flute, harp, cello) and Sarabande and Rigaudon (oboe, viola, piano) not added: no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Kiel, Friedrich
composers_checked.note: Complete: all 15 pages judged (16 works). 9 kept: the 3 piano quartets and 2 piano quintets (cpo, Marco Polo), trios Nos. 1, 5, 6, 7 (Genberg Trio, Abegg Trio); 7 works skipped as unrecorded (trios Nos. 2-4, the Op. 53 quartets, the two waltz sets). Wikipedia work list gives no further chamber works.

composers_checked.name: Bargiel, Woldemar
composers_checked.note: Complete: all 7 pages kept (8 works). Everything is on cpo (Orpheus Quartet 2018), Hyperion (Divertimenti 2024; Leonore Piano Trio 2024) or Dabringhaus und Grimm (Trio Parnassus 1998). Op. 15b is the quartet published with the Octet, Op. 15a.

composers_checked.name: Gernsheim, Friedrich
composers_checked.note: Complete: all 13 pages kept; every work is on cpo (Diogenes Quartet, Triendl), Audite, Brilliant, Audax, Toccata or Antes. Gap check: String Quintet No. 2, Op. 89 added. The String Trio (1900, Amadeus edition 2013) not added: no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Gouvy, Louis Théodore
composers_checked.note: Complete for the IMSLP pages; gap check partial. Added the Bru Zane quartet Op. 56 No. 2 and the three flute serenades (Toccata). Op. 24 rests on an IMSLP note and a blog review of the Clavier/Saroglou recording (medium confidence; no catalogue entry seen).

The juvenile Haydn-based quartet for flute, oboe, viola and cello is not added: no recording found.

composers_checked.name: Goetz, Hermann

composers_checked.name: Wolf, Hugo
composers_checked.note: Complete: all 3 pages kept (the Italian Serenade is the benchmark); Wolf has no other chamber works.

note: Recordings were found through Deezer album and track lists (public API, timings used for durations), MusicBrainz releases (d'Indy, Volkmann, Weingartner), label pages (Toccata, tacet, Europadisc, Apple Classical), IMSLP page notes, 11 web searches and 2 page fetches; the Apple iTunes API stayed blocked and Naxos and Presto were not used. Weak spots: d'Indy Op. 7 (a 2026 self-released disc and an AllMusic listing), Gouvy Op. 24 (an IMSLP note and a blog review, no catalogue entry seen), Goetz Op. 16 (scoring with double bass from IMSLP). Not added for lack of a confirmed scoring or recording: Gouvy String Quintet No. 6 in E minor (Phaia 2019) and the Nonetto, Sérénade en octuor and Septuor (Farao 2025), d'Indy's Concert Op. 89 (string orchestra), Bruckner WAB 210 (Kitzler exercise), Foote's At Dusk, Borodin's juvenile quartet for flute, oboe, viola and cello. Eras: Volkmann early-romantic, the others late-romantic by the usual reading of their main period.
